# Draft:Abejukolo Ward I

Abejukolo
Abejukolo Ward I is a ward in Omala LGA. It is the most populus ward as well as the seat of government of Omala LGA.
It compromises of the township of Abejukolo only. The Government official representing Abejukolo in Omala Local Government Council is known as the Councilor.
Igala is the language of the natives, particularly the Ife dialect.
The Abejukolo District Head is the traditional head of Abejukolo Ward I and II.
Areas in Abejukolo Ward I are:
* Odo Etito (Sabon Gari)
* Oleji I
* Oleji II
* Ola Omala
* Ojuwo aji Enefu (Ojuwo GSS)
